hypotheses.justification: The theorem mentions K, and DecidableEq K is instance-implicit and mentions only K, so it is automatically included (the file disables linter.unusedSectionVars, so no warning appears). The proof uses only field algebra: div_eq_div_iff, linear_combination, mul_eq_zero and sub_eq_zero. None of these needs decidable equality, so `omit [DecidableEq K] in` leaves the statement and proof valid unchanged.
